subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: Jamil once had an experience of a river journey when he was in class 6. It was a weekly bazar day, and many people were returning home with bags and baskets. As the weather turned (a) ------- after sunset, everyone rushed to get on the ferry boat. The boatman warned them, but nobody (b) -------. As a result, the (c) ------- boat sank in the middle of the river. Luckily, all passengers swam to safety, though they lost some of their belongings. Jamil was not on the boat because he noticed the crowd and decided to (d) ------- for the next one. The teacher appreciated his (e) -------. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) stormy; (b) listened; (c) overloaded; (d) wait; (e) decision; ● st ●
